choices.why: No mustard velvet sofa is in the catalog, so this warm cognac three-seater, 193 cm wide, is the closest to a golden tone and suits the long right wall.
A natural rattan tub armchair, exactly as requested, that adds a light boho texture by the balcony.
At 335x239 cm it is the only rug big enough to sit under both the sofa and the armchair, and its blue with orange and white pattern brings plenty of color.
Patterned woven cushions in navy and red that pick up the rug's colors and stand out against the cognac leather.
Cobalt-blue embossed ceramic pots that echo the rug and cushions; place them on the bookcase and in the corners.
Low (43 cm) and wide (140 cm), it fits under the window and its warm wood and black metal work with the coffee table.
A round 110 cm table in warm wood that is well proportioned for the sofa and the large rug.
Its turned column and linen shade give a warm, lived-in look that suits a boho room.
A geometric navy and cream throw with fringe that ties the blues of the rug and pots to the sofa.

answer.why: A golden-brown sofa, natural rattan and warm wood are livened up with blue and orange-red tones from the rug, cushions, pots and throw, for a cheerful, lived-in boho look on the parquet. None of the sofas is mustard velvet; the cognac leather is the closest in warmth.
